Definition: a sparkling gem, probably the ruby
BiblicalUsage: Kadkod is a sparkling gem, probably the ruby — named among the jewels Tyre traded for and among the stones God promises for the walls of the restored Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the same jewel Tyre sold for profit, God sets in the walls of His city, and what the world trades, He builds with.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
